method: Exact digit-string tie inspection, no floating point at any step: each input was kept as its exact decimal digit string; the tail beyond the second fractional digit was classified as below-half, above-half, or an exact tie (third fractional digit 5 followed by nothing or only zeros); exact ties kept the two-decimal truncation when its hundredths digit was even and incremented it otherwise; increments carried right-to-left through the digit string (999999.995 -> 1,000,000.00); the integer part was then comma-grouped every three digits and negative amounts were rendered as unsigned values in parentheses after rounding (half-even is symmetric, so rounding the magnitude equals rounding the signed value). Full per-item working is in first-derivation.md. A corroborating re-derivation by a disjoint method (pure scaled-integer arithmetic) in an isolated child process, with deterministic per-item agreement comparison, is pending integration per child/integration-plan.json.
